title: Confidence in confidence distributions!
summary: The recent article `Satellite conjunction analysis and the false confidence theorem' (Balch, Martin, and Ferson, 2019, Proceedings of the Royal Society, Series A) points to certain difficulties with Bayesian analysis when used for models for satellite conjuntion and ensuing operative decisions. Here we supplement these previous analyses and findings with further insights, uncovering what we perceive of as being the crucial points, explained in a prototype setup where exact analysis is attainable.
